mechanism: Conversion of numerical state observations into semantic trajectory descriptions for an evaluator LLM in a closed-loop code refinement cycle
evidence_scope: Our framework transforms numerical state observations from UA V operations into semantic trajectory descriptions to enhance the evaluator LLM's understanding of UA V dynamics for precise feedback generation.
evidence_role: we propose a closed-loop LLM-driven UA V operation code generation framework that enables reliable UA V operations powered by effective feedback and re- finement using two LLM modules, i.e., a Code Generator and an Evaluator.
